title: 美股Nasdaq周一跌2.5%、A股科创50跌逾5%，AI板块全线承压
summary: 受英伟达CEO换帅后AI叙事不确定性冲击，周一美股大跌：Nasdaq收跌2.5%，标普500跌1.9%，道指跌1.4%，费城半导体指数跌3.43%。A股同步走弱，科创50跌逾5%，创业板指跌4.37%，沪指跌0.87%，科创资产领跌，宽基ETF尾盘放量护盘。
why: 全面回调提升持仓个股波动率，AI赛道个股Beta系统性下移；sell put策略需评估行权价缓冲是否充足，大盘恐慌情绪或推高隐含波动率，提供阶段性卖出期权机会。

title: Nvidia Q3 FY2027 Earnings Due After Close Today; Consensus Revenue ~$108.85B, First Report Under Interim CEO
summary: Nvidia reports fiscal Q3 2027 results (Aug-Oct 2026) after US market close today, with analyst consensus at $108.85B revenue and EPS of $2.47. This marks the first earnings report since Jensen Huang's Nov. 12 resignation; interim CEO Colette Kress will host the call. Guidance and AI infrastructure demand commentary will be critical for near-term market direction across AI/chip names.
why: 今日财报是本周最高风险事件，英伟达指引将定调AI硬件需求叙事；管理层换届背景下市场对战略一致性有疑虑，波动率偏高，财报后隐含波动率回落可能是sell put窗口；关注Blackwell出货、中国出口限制影响及2027年数据中心资本支出指引。

title: Nvidia Board Rules Out Jensen Huang Return; Permanent CEO Search Continues With CFO Kress as Interim
summary: Nvidia's board confirmed it is not in discussions to bring back Jensen Huang as CEO, per CNBC. CFO Colette Kress leads the company as interim CEO while the board evaluates internal and external candidates. Huang resigned Nov. 12 following a board investigation tied to an affair with an individual alleged to have contact with Chinese intelligence; Congress has also called Huang to testify.
why: 延续报道：英伟达CEO辞任续集。董事会排除回归选项表明权力过渡是确定性事件，但永久CEO人选不明确性是长期估值折价来源；今日三季报电话会将是首次在无创始人情况下的业绩指引，对AI策略叙事尤为关键，影响持仓的期权定价中枢。

title: Anthropic IPO Prices Tomorrow on Nasdaq; $70-78/Share Range, Valuation ~$1.4 Trillion, 6x Oversubscribed
summary: Anthropic (ticker: ANT) is set to price its Nasdaq IPO on November 18 and begin trading November 19. The offering of 825 million shares targets $70-78 each, implying a valuation of approximately $1.4 trillion. The book is reportedly 6x oversubscribed. Bloomberg had earlier cited potential for $1.5T+ valuation. The IPO comes against the backdrop of AI market volatility caused by the Nvidia CEO departure.
why: Anthropic上市将为AI平台公司提供新的公开市场估值锚点；若定价高于预期，对AI赛道（谷歌、阿里云、腾讯AI业务）构成情绪催化；若市场因英伟达事件情绪低迷而压低定价，则反过来抑制AI溢价估值逻辑，密切关注明日定价区间。

title: Tencent Q3 2026 Earnings Preview: AI Spending Erodes Profit; Revenue ~RMB 210B, Ad Growth +18% a Bright Spot
summary: Tencent (0700.HK) reports Q3 2026 results on November 18. Analyst consensus forecasts revenue of ~RMB 210.24 billion (+9% YoY), but non-IFRS operating profit is expected to decline ~3% YoY due to AI-related OpEx estimated at up to RMB 16 billion quarterly. Excluding strategic AI spend, underlying operating profit growth would be +13%. Advertising growth of +18% YoY is the standout.
why: 腾讯明日财报是港股本周最重要事件；AI投入拖累利润是短期市场关注的核心，但广告18%增长与非AI业务韧性是正面信号。管理层对AI回报时间表的指引将直接影响短期put期权定价，持仓需关注是否下调全年指引。

title: 阿里发布Qwen4-Max，2.4T参数支持百万上下文，API单任务费用降逾六成
summary: 阿里巴巴于11月16日正式发布Qwen4-Max，总参数2.4T、激活参数71B，支持百万级上下文，具备原生视觉能力。在Terminal-Bench 4.0编程评测中，单任务平均费用较上一代降低58%，Token用量从289K降至151K。模型已上线阿里云API，编程领域全球盲测排名第六，小尺寸版本将陆续开源。
why: Qwen4-Max发布强化阿里在中国大模型竞争格局中的地位，低成本API策略有望带动阿里云收入增长；叠加平头哥HK独立上市预期（市传2027年、募资$20-30亿），构成9988.HK/BABA估值修复逻辑的双重催化。

title: SK Hynix Plans New HBM4 Equipment Orders for P&T6 Site Despite Nvidia CEO Uncertainty
summary: SK Hynix is reportedly in talks with equipment makers for new HBM4 tools at its Cheongju P&T6 site, targeting a 2027 H1 production ramp. The company expects HBM4 to surpass HBM3E in both shipment volume and revenue in Q4 2026. Industry sources note Nvidia leadership uncertainty but say the company's demand commitments remain firm through 2029. Separately, SK Hynix pledged $1.05B to support domestic chip suppliers and a $655M testing center.
why: SK海力士坚持HBM4扩产表明AI算力硬件需求侧尚未因英伟达CEO变动松动，对HBM相关仓位（南方两倍做多/CSOP）有短期支撑；但今日英伟达三季报指引是关键——若指引偏弱，HBM4订单节奏或受压。

title: Nvidia Cuts Intel Stake by ~54M Shares; Intel Drops ~3.6% on Disclosure
summary: Nvidia disclosed a reduction in its Intel holdings from approximately 214.8 million to 161.1 million shares (~25% cut), likely via its Q3 2026 13F filing. Intel shares dropped approximately 3.6% on Monday following the disclosure, adding to pressure from an extended post-earnings decline. Nvidia originally acquired its ~$5 billion Intel stake in September 2025 as part of a chip co-development deal.
why: 英伟达减持英特尔是合作信心下降的信号；若今日三季报指引显示自研或竞争性架构倾向加剧，可能进一步压制INTC。对英特尔仓位需关注下行风险，代工战略与AI芯片路线的不确定性叠加管理层压力仍是折价来源。
